good service but not entirely without issues. Its the old getting past reception that is sometimes a problem (like many other surgeries). I have heart disease (heart attack in 1997 and open heart surgery), raised type 2 diabetes issues , Prostate problems, (weight loss and low appetite and difficulty peeing), high blood pressure and feeling tired all the time and other age related issues. I called to make an appointment for a blood test after a recent health check call from my GP. My cholesterol had risen and my blood pressure was up and my blood sugars were  way above what they should be. As a result I called to arrange a blood test. Not so easy as you think. A planned 2minute call to agree an appointment for a single blood test ended up taking almost 15 minutes of discussion whilst raising the ante at the same time. (The receptionist was perfectly polite and remained calm but I came away with even higher blood pressure. It seems I am not entitled to blood tests just like that. I am somewhat restricted and have to wait for a particular time cycle to occur  before I am entitled to \"another blood test\" despite the fact that I have experienced recent noticeable changes with regard to my prostate problems. I offered to pay for the blood tests if needed but my offer was rejected.  Finally after much debate we reached agreement when the receptionist   proposed passing my request to a GP who will decide whether I am entitled to a blood test or not.. I am not asking them to move mountains but a single blood test to pacify my concerns is surely not beyond the realm of possibility's. Having said this, I am otherwise very satisfied by the level of service  and the staffs attention to patient needs with Church View who have up until now come up with the goods when needed without issue. .  will treat this as a one
